title: Position State — Max-One-Active
description: Strict indefinite max-one-active per instrument (Option B). Active gauge + dropped/passed/cleared rates + trading_alerts audit. Source: ActiveSignalFeedbackFunction + ComputeAlertLogs -> metrics (flink-metrics-otel -> otel-collector:4318) + trading_alerts. No TTL — CLOSED/ADMIN_CLEAR only.

panels.title: Active positions — compute.signal.active.count (indefinite, no TTL)
panels.description: Best-effort per-subtask gauge inc on pass, dec on CLOSED/ADMIN_CLEAR. Exact count is Position_State lake WHERE status=OPEN. Stuck ACTIVE stays blocked forever until explicit CLOSED.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x, avg(value) AS y FROM "metrics" WHERE metric_name LIKE '%compute_signal_active_count%' GROUP BY x

panels.title: Dropped vs Passed — compute.signal.dropped.active_exists / compute.signal.passed
panels.description: Dropped = suppressed because ACTIVE exists (indefinite block, wait CLOSED). Passed = first signal for instrument that created ACTIVE. Rates per bucket.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x, count(*) AS y FROM "metrics" WHERE metric_name LIKE '%compute_signal_dropped_active_exists%' GROUP BY x
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x, count(*) AS y FROM "metrics" WHERE metric_name LIKE '%compute_signal_passed%' GROUP BY x

panels.title: Cleared — CLOSED / ADMIN_CLEAR (compute.signal.cleared.*)
panels.description: CLOSED = normal Nautilus feedback clearing ACTIVE. ADMIN_CLEAR = break-glass ops clear (also emits trading_alerts active-signal-admin-clear WARN).

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x, count(*) AS y FROM "metrics" WHERE metric_name LIKE '%compute_signal_cleared_closed%' GROUP BY x
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x, count(*) AS y FROM "metrics" WHERE metric_name LIKE '%compute_signal_cleared_admin%' GROUP BY x

panels.title: Trading alerts — active-signal-cleared / admin-clear (trading_alerts)
panels.description: Structured audit from ComputeAlertLogs.emitAlertLog() via OTLP -> trading_alerts. ADMIN_CLEAR is WARN. Correlate with gauge for stuck ACTIVE incidents.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, event, severity, body FROM "trading_alerts" WHERE event IN ('active-signal-cleared','active-signal-admin-clear') ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
